# Upsun Developer

> Upsun Developer — documentation, guides, and more.

## Home

- [Upsun Developer Center](https://developer.upsun.com/index.md): Documentation, guides, and API references for Upsun Cloud and Upsun Dispatch — covering the full software lifecycle from plan, code, review, and optimize to build, test, deploy, and run.

## Dispatch

### Docs

- [Upsun Dispatch](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/index.md): Docs, guides, and references for Upsun Dispatch, governed AI-agent workflows to plan, code, review, and optimize your software. Connect a repo, leave a comment, and Upsun Dispatch takes it from there.

#### Get Started

- [Get Started with Upsun Dispatch](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/get-started/index.md): Set up your account, organization, code integrations, and AI model keys for Upsun Dispatch.
- [Quickstart](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/get-started/quickstart.md): Connect a repository, store a model key, choose a default model integration, and run your first Upsun Dispatch code review.
- [Get support](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/get-started/support.md): Find out how to get help if you're experiencing issues with Upsun Dispatch.

#### Integrations

- [Integration overview](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/integrations/index.md): Connect version control system, ticketing, notification, and AI model integrations to Upsun Dispatch.

##### VCS integrations

- [Set up GitHub](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/integrations/github.md): Connect a GitHub App installation to your Upsun Dispatch organization so Upsun Dispatch can review pull requests.
- [Set up GitLab](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/integrations/gitlab.md): Connect a GitLab project to Upsun Dispatch so Upsun Dispatch can review merge requests.

##### Ticketing integrations

- [Set up Jira](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/integrations/jira.md): Connect a Jira site to Upsun Dispatch as a ticketing integration for your organization.
- [Set up Linear](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/integrations/linear.md): Connect Linear to your Upsun Dispatch organization as a ticketing integration.

##### Notification integrations

- [Set up Slack](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/integrations/slack.md): Connect Slack to your Upsun Dispatch organization and configure Slack notification rules.

##### AI Models

- [AI models](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/models/index.md): Store the model keys Upsun Dispatch uses to run AI-backed workflows.
- [Store your Anthropic key](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/models/anthropic.md): Store the Anthropic API key your organization uses for Upsun Dispatch workflows.
- [Store your OpenAI key](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/models/openai.md): Store the OpenAI API key your organization uses for Upsun Dispatch workflows.

#### Workflows

- [Workflows in Upsun Dispatch](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/workflows/index.md): Understand the built-in Upsun Dispatch workflows, how they start, and how workflow settings control their behavior.

##### Built-in workflows

- [Built-in workflows](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/workflows/builtin.md): Use Upsun Dispatch built-in workflows to turn issues into pull or merge requests and review pull or merge requests.
- [Code review](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/workflows/code-review.md): Use Upsun Dispatch Code review to review GitHub pull requests and GitLab merge requests with an LLM-backed review agent.
- [Issue to code](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/workflows/issue-to-code.md): Use Upsun Dispatch Issue to code to turn a GitHub issue, Jira ticket, or Linear issue into a planned code change and pull or merge request when supported by your version control integration.

#### Manage

- [Use the Upsun Dispatch console](https://developer.upsun.com/dispatch/docs/dashboard/index.md): Manage organizations, billing, repositories, workflow settings, runs, deliveries, notifications, and usage from the Upsun Dispatch web console.

- [Cloud (600 pages)](https://developer.upsun.com/_llms/cloud.txt): Documentation for Cloud.
